verified_facts: HMLR spatial data is captured against British National Grid
polygon coordinates are X and Y values on British National Grid
QGIS can reproject EPSG:27700 data to other coordinate reference systems
British National Grid to WGS84 conversion can introduce errors
some converted features may shift by up to 15 metres
native BNG should be preserved for measurement joins
reprojected display coordinates must not silently replace native measurement coordinates
quality_effect: Separates native BNG measurement geometry from potentially shifted web-display reprojections.
